notes.title: Update 0.2.5 Super Aircraft with 18G Overload! ——New game parameter settings
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow players! [/h1]

We are very happy to announce that 2D Dogfight has released an important update. In this update, we have added the function of customize some in-game parameters. Players can change the maximum overload limit of the aircraft, aircraft strength, etc. in the settings interface. You can also turn on options such as proportional navigate of air-to-air missiles and unlimited ammunition or fuel. This update will add more fun to the game and give players a different flying experience!

[h1] Brand new settings, DIY your gaming experience! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/54b8d514fc2442ad72ca5e8f9757fd2d25c9a6f0.jpg[/img]

There are seven newly added game setting options:

Limited ammo: The default checkbox is selected. If not selected, the aircraft will automatically reload to full ammunition after firing all the bullets.

Limited fuel: The default checkbox  is selected. If not selected, the aircraft's fuel will not be consumed during flight.

Limited flare/chaff: The default checkbox is selected. If not selected, the aircraft will automatically reload the countermeasures to the full state after using all the flares or chaff.

Air-to-Air missile proportional navigation method: The default checkbox is unselected. If selected, all air-to-air missiles will apply the proportional navigation method (for details on the proportional navigation method, see the previous update package 0.2.4)

Overload limit multiplier: The default is 1. If the value is adjusted to n, the overload limit of the aircraft in a specific state will be magnified by n times.

Speed limit multiplier: The default is 1.1. If the value is adjusted to n, the aircraft will be damaged when it exceeds the n times of limit IAS or Mach number.

Aircraft strength multiplier: The default is 1. If the value is adjusted to n, the aircraft's strength will be increased by n times.

Players can freely adjust the above option values according to their own preferences to play the game, but these option settings will not take effect in online game. In online game, the above parameters are all default values!

[h1]Update HD images of aircraft[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/2ec36672a366d813d92447a5c27cb633485c21c4.jpg[/img]

Since the 2D Dogfight game did not have a zoom-in or out function when it was first released, the images of many aircraft were not HD. Although subsequent aircrafts added to the game have HD images, the old aircraft are still using the old images. From this update, our game will gradually complete HD images for old aircrafts that do not have HD images. The following are the aircrafts that will add HD images in this update:

A-4B, A-7E, A-10A, AJ37, F-86F-25,
F-16A Block 15, F-16C Block 30/50/52+, F-16V Block 20,
MiG-15bis, MiG-17, MiG-17F, J-10A, J-10B, J-10C,
MiG-29, MiG-29K, MiG-35, EF-2000 tranche 2/4 Typhoon,
F-2A, F-4B/D/E/EJ Kai/F ICE/F/J/K, F-5E, F-8D, G.91R3, Hunter F.6

2. G.91R3 image size correction

notes.title: Update 0.2.4 Where are you flying? - New Missile Guide Logic!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow players! [/h1]

We are very happy to announce that 2D Dogfight is having an important update. In this update, we have optimized the guidance logic of missiles, making the performance of various types of air-to-air and surface-to-air missiles in the game more interesting!

[h1] What will the missile do when faced with flare/chaff? [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/64e480eeb932377faa0fadaf3e79c42dbe733936.jpg[/img]

In previous games, our air-to-air or surface-to-air missiles would remain stationary in horizontal flight when faced with flare/chaff, unable to guide towards the locked target. In this update, we have modified the logic of the missile when facing jamming objects. After the seeker is jammed by the contermeasures, the missile will fly to the coordinates of the flare/chaff and then explosied. This new mechanism is closer to reality. And it will make the game more interesting!

[h1]Proportional navigation method—new missile tracking logic[/h1]

In previous games, missiles would track a locked target from behind after being launched. Now, we have implemented a new tracking logic - the proportional navigation method. The missile will predict the target's upcoming location, then fly to the front of the target, waiting for the target to hit the missile! This logic is more close to reality and also greatly increases the ability of various air-to-air and air-to-surface missiles in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/0323e4dba12fc0757972227dba819c1c86d79a33.jpg[/img]
[b] However, given that the implementation of this mechanism will increase the difficulty of many campaigns to an insurmountable height, our game will still use the previous missile tracking logic by default. If you want to play with the Proportional navigation method, please go to Change the player name to "All_Missile_Guider" in the game settings. When using this name, the missile will apply the proportional navigation method! [/b]

notes.title: Update 0.2.3 New Missiles are coming!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow players! [/h1]

We are very happy to announce that 2D Dogfight is having an important update, in which two new air-to-air missiles will be added to the game!

[h1]R-37M, the Axehead from Russia[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/8e0baa404228f4a5b5ce4faadc9ba4e44bcdf7d6.jpg[/img]

The R-37M is a long-range air-to-air missile developed by Russia. It uses an active radar homing seeker and has an extremely long range. It has excellent long-distance interception capabilities for high-altitude and low-altitude penetration bombers, but its ability to attack maneuverable targets is relatively poor. In the new version, this new long-range air-to-air missile will be added to the arsenal of Su-35S, Su-57 and Su-75 aircraft, providing effective long-range attack means for later Russian fighter aircraft. Make up for the lack of range of the previous R-77 missile!

[h1]Astra Mk.1, the new weapon of the Indian Air Force[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/d16c0bd530ed3eb8aa87e66c57a67eda94a3b9d2.jpg[/img]

Astra Mk.1 is the fourth-generation medium-range air-to-air missile developed by India. It uses an active radar homing seeker and has the ability to fire and forget. It has a long range and is also capable of attacking highly maneuverable targets. And it has excellent anti-jamming ability. In the new version, this new medium-range air-to-air missile will be added to the arsenal of the Su-30MKI fighter, providing it with a new and unique attack method!

This update also includes the following:

1. Missile name change: AIM-120A -> AIM-120B

2. Fixed the issue where command-guided missiles would be jammed by chaff

3. Fixed the problem that command guidance missiles can still use command guidance after the carrier aircraft is destroyed.

Thank you everyone for your support of the game! We will continue to work hard to bring you a better gaming experience

notes.title: Major Update 0.2.2 Mission Editor is released, Let's Create a Brand New World！
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow players! [/h1]

We are pleased to announce that the mission editor function of 2D Dogfight is officially launched.

[h1]Customize your own tasks[/h1]

The mission editor function can help players design their own campaign missions: players can choose to load any map, place the vehicles they want (whether aircraft or tanks) at any location, and set their parameters. Set the time, place and mission objectives for the campaign. After completing the production of a mission map, players can upload it to the workshop to share their custom missions.

[h1]Introduction to using the editor[/h1]

In the editor, you can move the camera by touching the border with the mouse, or you can use the same keys as the free camera mode in the game to control the camera .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/62ea8c22064845be4115389cdd50595c94b9f1fa.jpg[/img]

Click "Map" in the "Attribute" menu to edit the map, weather, time, and actual map size used for this mission. The default map option is Custom, but the game currently does not have a custom map feature, so it is recommended to select an existing map in the drop-down menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/6fddf21f600b80080c0874dfec93d7912b3ecd70.jpg[/img]

Click on aircraft and vehicles in the "items" menu to place aircraft and ground vehicles in the game. The first aircraft placed will become the aircraft used by the player, with an ID of 0. All aircraft and vehicles have a digital ID. Once placed, you can click the placed aircraft or vehicle to view the ID. If players want to delete, copy, or cut certain placed objects, they can use the corresponding functions in the "Edit" column.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/afde7fbf66c95695a3a4743e6d660e5d03f16c13.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/efa2a047d90bd11af1d4bc7b6f0d4e5a37f2ed67.jpg[/img]

Click Mission in the "Attributes" menu to edit the mission objectives in the mission editing window. The list on the left is the targets that players need to protect, and the right is the targets that players need to destroy or capture. Just select the ID or airport name of the corresponding object to add.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/fef1e1f3d1b721a2f07f5e3c1dad40e1ff14407f.jpg[/img]

In addition, players can also set the types of aircraft available in the hangar, which is very useful when switching aircraft after reloading at the airport. Players can also select "Description" in the Attributes column and set the name, time, description and cover image of the mission in the window. These contents will be displayed in the corresponding items after you upload it to the workshop.

After editing the mission, save it in the file menu. Click Test to start the game. Click Upload to upload your customized task to the workshop.

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 New Particle system! Reduced to smithereens in a blast!
notes.content:
Hello fellow players!

We are very happy to announce that 2D Dogfight has received an important update. In this update, we have added new particle effects to the game, bringing a new visual experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/64441ad95f42886852d4d4a1a4f6ae93a5c68d32.jpg[/img]

In previous versions of the game, when the player's bullet hit a unit, the bullet would disappear, and the hit target would only be indicated by lightness and darkness to indicate the degree of damage it suffered. The new version introduces new particle effects. When a bullet hits the ground, an aircraft or a tank, the bullet will explode and produce black particles. These black particles will randomly splash around to simulate the wreckage of enemy aircraft being hit. Or the dust raised by the explosion on the ground makes the game more realistic. In addition to bullets, particle effects are also used in the explosion effects of missiles and bombs. Splashing particles will appear together with the explosion flames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/8290a0ce190c8ef37a1967e3c6b14b8e03c125bf.jpg[/img]

But it should be noted that the particle effect will only appear when the weapon causes enough damage to the target. If the weapon's damage to the target is too low, the projectile will not explode into pellets but will bounce off the opponent.

This update also includes the following:

1. The collision volume of aircraft and tanks has been modified. The collision volume of aircraft is now directly related to the size of the body, unlike in the past, when all aircraft had the same collision volume.

notes.title: Remaking history - new DLC "World War II - Western Front Fighters" is released!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow players! [/h1]

We are very happy to announce that the new 2D Dogfight DLC "World War II - Western Front Fighters" is officially released today! This DLC brings exciting new aircrafts and a new gaming experience. Players can also get new UI themes and main menu wallpapers through DLC. In addition, the new DLC also includes a brand new single-player campaign of World War II. Come and create your own history!

[h1]New aircraft[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/fcb36c45f4fca07ac1ec5ad72e3e387d70fe5b28.jpg[/img]
The DLC "World War II - Western Front Fighters" brings 35 exciting new aircrafts to the game. They are all classic fighters active in the Western Front battlefield of World War II, including the American P-38 Lightning, P-47 Thunderbolt, P-51 Mustang, B-17 Flying Fortress, British Hawker Hurricane, Supermarine Spitfire, Lancaster, De Havilland Mosquito, German Bf-109, Fw-190 and Stuka dive bomber. In addition to these propeller fighters, there are also the earliest jet fighters that appeared in World War II - the British Meteor and the German Me-262

Players who purchased the "World War II - Western Front Fighters" DLC can freely use these new aircrafts in customization mode and the new LAN online mode. These famous World War II aircraft will bring you a completely different flying experience.

[h1]New campaign[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/c91c135573faaa2ec5bb59d59dec2ac99c40c4d1.jpg[/img]
The DLC "World War II - Western Front Fighters" also includes 8 new single-player campaigns. Players can choose to join the Allies or Axis, and participate in air battles or ground support missions over Western Europe and North Africa in World War II. The new campaigns include famous World War II battles in history, such as the Battle of Britain, the Battle of Tunisia, and Battle of Bulge, as well as fictional historical missions based on World War II, such as Germany's implementation of the Operation Sea Lion in 1945. Players can freely choose the campaign missions they want to experience without having to worry about getting stuck if you don't finnish previous Stage. I hope players can experience the completely different combat modes of the propeller fighter era in these battles and gain a more interesting gaming experience!

Thank you to all players for your strong support of the 2D Dogfight game. I wish you all a happy game!

notes.title: Major Update 0.2.0 Graphics Revolution
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Players![/h1]

We are thrilled to announce that 2D Dogfight has brought a major update to your screens today! This upgrade promises to revolutionize your gaming experience.

[h1]A Fresh World, Stunning Visuals[/h1]

We have completely reimagined all in-game maps, bidding farewell to the previous simplistic style. Get ready to immerse yourself in a brand-new visual feast with more dazzling explosion effects and lifelike damage visuals.

New Map Backgrounds:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/2f66e3a2ca9fa733b201d1ffe77d0866196d9139.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/2db3385ee39bf05e50ef7d42562cdafa54bda1b7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/f564f2581eb2e431626fccc3b2f7601fe3e81d06.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/98cbf9b44ce728319f009b73bda6ddfbfd649eea.jpg[/img]

Explosion Effects:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/07516e80d057cdcfb58738a8af1d4dff4717ce78.jpg[/img]

Aircraft Smoking from Damage:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/21091c900d16c0d0b403cc3112b246fbb187d846.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mouse Aiming Mode[/h1]

We have introduced an all-new mouse aiming mode, granting you pinpoint control within the game. You can effortlessly toggle to mouse aiming mode by configuring your keybindings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/24268b6c0cb48b003fd2946b83eb6c1de61a33bd.jpg[/img]

In this mode, your aircraft will automatically align with the mouse cursor, allowing you to fire with the left mouse button and launch weapons like bombs, missiles, and rockets with the right mouse button. You can also zoom in and out using the mouse wheel. Furthermore, while in mouse aiming mode, you can seamlessly integrate keyboard commands, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience!

[h1]Free Camera Mode[/h1]

We are also introducing a brand-new free camera mode, accessible by configuring your keybindings. Now, you can switch to free camera mode and explore the game world on your own terms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/78c36915e8c0b04adaad28ce4232dedd98932c17.jpg[/img]

In free camera mode, you can control your camera's movement using the keyboard's arrow keys, freeing it from following your aircraft, providing you with a more liberating gaming experience.

[h1]Kinetic Damage Mechanism[/h1]

We have revamped the game's machine guns with a new kinetic damage mechanism (currently applicable to the Browning M3, with several similar weapons to be included in the upcoming World War II Western Front DLC). Machine gun damage is now directly proportional to the kinetic energy of the bullets, meaning that machine guns are most effective at close range, with damage diminishing significantly at longer distances.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to all players for your tremendous support of the 2D Dogfight game. Wishing everyone an exciting gaming experience!

notes.title: Update 0.1.9 Workshop is released! Come and customize your own fighter~
notes.content:
Greetings, players!

We are very pleased to announce the release of 2D Dogfight's Workshop feature! Players can edit their own aircraft skins and upload them to the Workshop to share with other players, as well as subscribe to other players' skins in the Workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/b66222dd6abda9bb35498dcab45f159559e6c982.png[/img]

The image above shows the in-game skin editor interface, which players can open to edit aircraft skins in the window of custom games, campaigns, and multiplayer games.

The skin editor provides the management function for each skin scheme of the airplane, players can add new skin schemes (create templates or import pictures from local) and delete the existing ones, meanwhile, the skin editor also has a simple painting tool, players can use the paintbrush, eraser, stickers and other tools in the painting tool to doodle and modify the picture of the aircraft. After completing the picture, you can click save, or fill in the description and upload it directly to the Workshop via the upload button.

The Workshop has already provided some of the game's official aircraft skins, such as the F-16's Thunderbirds skin, J-10's 81 Air Show Team skin, Typhoon's Battle of Britain anniversary skin, and MiG-29 of Ukrainian Air Force.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/168576e4e5e211f3de141564c342682c6bf4ea2f.jpg[/img]

This update also includes the following:

1. Optimized the aircraft's flight control. In the past, when the player released the keyboard while doing a maneuver, the aircraft's angle of attack would be adjusted in an instant. Now, when the aircraft returns from a maneuver, the angle of attack will be lowered at the normal pitch rate, instead of being corrected instantly.

2. Solved some problems caused by window opened in the game when minimized.

3. The range and maximum speed of the following surface-to-air missiles have been reduced:
MIM-14 Nike Hercules

notes.title: Update 0.1.8: Radar Takes Control! - Who's the Next Lucky Target?
notes.content:
Dear players,

Greetings to all!

We are excited to announce a significant update for 2D Dogfight, introducing the manual radar lock function.

In previous versions of the game, when the aircraft's radar detected multiple targets, the radar automatically assigned a suitable target for each radar-guided missile launched. However, in certain situations, the automatically assigned targets may not align with the player's intended targets. Therefore, we have implemented the manual radar lock function, allowing players to manually assign targets for their missiles using the radar lock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/e67ebcca5221de10f9c8e2235c2f457bbe81c13f.png[/img]

By pressing the X key (default keybinding, customizable in the settings), the radar will lock onto the enemy aircraft with the smallest angle relative to the aircraft's nose. The radar lock is indicated by a white border around the radar indicator arrow (green arrow) pointing to the locked target. All missiles launched by the player will track this locked target. The radar lock requires the target to be within the range and detection capabilities of the onboard radar. If the target flies outside this detection range, the radar lock will be released, and the white border around the radar indicator arrow will disappear. Additionally, the use of chaff by the target may also cause the radar lock to be released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/b217792a2c39d966abcc4e1f5daa7c6c961f5c86.png[/img]

Not every situation calls for manual radar lock. For instance, when the player intends to simultaneously engage multiple targets with multiple missiles, we recommend either pressing X to release the lock on the previously locked target or not locking any target from the beginning, allowing the radar's automatic assignment to handle multi-target engagement. Otherwise, all missiles will fly towards the one target you have manually locked.

This update also includes the following:

1. Fixed a bug in multiplayer mode where initial speed and fuel were incorrect in certain cases.

2. Added relevant content about manual radar lock to the tutorial.

3. Implemented a new font for in-game text, addressing font display issues experienced by some players in certain language clients.

We appreciate your support for the game! We will continue striving to provide an enhanced gaming experience for all.

notes.title: Conquer the Skies: Explore the "Lord of Sky" DLC and LAN Multiplayer Game!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, fellow players![/h1]

We are thrilled to announce the release of the brand-new DLC "Lord of Sky" for 2D Dogfight! This DLC brings exciting new aircraft and a fresh gaming experience. Players will also enjoy new UI themes and main menu wallpapers included in the DLC. Moreover, the local network multiplayer mode will now be available for all players. Gather your friends and get ready to showcase your flying skills in the vast blue sky!

[h1]About the "Lord of Sky" DLC[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/ba25d83f76333115202afcd536c5bd992010e854.png[/img]

The "Lord of Sky" DLC introduces 12 thrilling new aircraft, offering you a wider selection of cool flying machines to engage in battles. These aircraft include:

F-22A Raptor: The world's first fifth-generation fighter aircraft, combining exceptional maneuverability, supersonic cruising, and high stealth capabilities.
FC-31 Gyrfalcon: A stealthy medium-sized fighter jet developed in China, known for its agility.
Su-75 Checkmate: A lightweight stealth fighter aircraft developed in Russia, possessing both mystery and power.
F-20 Tigershark: The successor to the F-5, an export-oriented fighter jet planned by Northrop Corporation.
JF-17 Thunder: A collaborative fighter jet developed by China and Pakistan.
Su-15 Flagon: The most numerous interceptor aircraft of the Soviet Air Defense Forces.
FA-18A Hornet: An early model of the FA-18 Hornet.
Su-37 Terminator: A new generation of side-mounted fighter aircraft that was developed but never reached full production after the dissolution of the Soviet Union.
J-8F Finback: An advanced variant of the J-8II fighter aircraft.
JA 37D Viggen: An advanced variant of the Swedish "Viggen" fighter aircraft.
F-104S ASA-M Starfighter: A unique Italian Starfighter aircraft.
Kfir C.7: A versatile multirole fighter jet autonomously developed by Israel.
Players who purchase the "Lord of Sky" DLC can freely use these new aircraft in custom mode and the brand-new local network multiplayer mode. These aircraft will bring more strategic and tactical choices to the game, allowing you to dominate the sky in exciting new ways!

[h1]About the Local Network Multiplayer Mode[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/95b38445fb8ff870ea599e555b44549a598c7628.png[/img]

In addition to the new aircraft, we are also introducing the local network multiplayer mode. After entering the game, players can click on the multiplayer option to enter the lobby. You can choose to create a room or search for existing game rooms in the lobby. You have the option to search for rooms in your own region or expand the search to neighboring countries or even half the globe. We recommend prioritizing rooms in your own region, as long distances may lead to unacceptable delays and significantly impact your gaming experience. If you want to invite friends to play together, simply click the invite button inside the room and invite them to join you in intense battles, experiencing the joy of aerial combat together.

We thank all players for their tremendous support of 2D Dogfight and wish everyone a pleasant gaming experience!

notes.title: Update 0.1.5: Improved Camera! Every Single Hair Can Be Seen Clearly
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, 2D Dogfight received an important update in which we have addressed several issues related to the game's field of view (FOV) as reported by players.

In the past, the FOV was fixed and too small, which greatly limited players' aerial combat experience. Therefore, in the new version of the game released with this update, we have added the ability to zoom in and out the FOV. Players can now set the keys for "zoom out" and "zoom in" in the key settings and adjust the FOV as per their preference while playing the game.

The following two images show the effects of the FOV zooming in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/353b894cb437adbe5be86f731b3fc5588ba9b7f8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/7c34ba10e9300c13f0a58c256f2515d56c84f1c2.png[/img]

In addition to the FOV zooming, the update also includes the following improvements:

1. Added a button to reset the key settings to default.

2. Optimized aircraft engine sound effects with separate audio clips for start-up, stable operation, and shutdown.

3. Corrected some typos in the Chinese text of certain campaigns.

4. The easy mode of the campaign now allows players to reload in the air. Players only need to fly into our airport range at an altitude below 1000 meters to replenish their supplies without landing.

5. The key to pause and resume the game can now be set in the key settings instead of being bound to the space button.

6. Based on player feedback, the "Press Esc to exit fullscreen mode" feature has been removed.

Thank you for playing 2D Dogfight, and we hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Are you ready to take off? 2D Dogfight is now released!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/h1]

I am excited to announce that my game, 2D Dogfight, is now released! This is a simple and fun 2D air combat game with some aerodynamic simulation. The idea of this 2D flight simulation game comes from my love of flying games and my desire to create unique games. Most of the flight simulation games I have played are three-dimensional, and many of them depict the flight characteristics of aircraft in great detail. However, two-dimensional aerial combat games seem to completely avoid simulation. Is there an unimagined path? So I want to create a 2D game that includes elements of flight simulation.

[h1][b]About the game mechanics[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/d2174936bade3dfbb922c0feb9896abb5cd4676a.png[/img]
Although 2D Dogfight includes elements of flight simulation, it does not mean that the game takes a purely hardcore simulator route. As a simple game, gameplay is still the most important consideration. The aerodynamic simulation in the game mainly includes the basic gravity and lift characteristics of the aircraft. When the player controls the aircraft to climb and maneuver, the speed will decrease, and when diving, the speed will increase. A series of energy conversions during flight give players more diverse tactical choices in air combat, just like many three-dimensional flight simulation games. However, since the aerial combat in my game takes place in a 2D world, the choices for maneuvering are simpler. Various aircraft in the game have their own unique flying performance. Their performance data is based on real historical data, but adjustments will be made for gameplay needs (some modern aircraft with performance data still classified as secret have no real data to refer, their data is purely designed for gameplay). 

In addition to controlling the aircraft, players also need to learn and understand various weapon systems of different aircraft, including their airborne radar performance, the use of various air-to-air and air-to-ground weapons. Therefore, I strongly recommend that players check the tutorial and relevant databases in the game instruction on the main menu before starting the game, so that you can master the operation skills of the game faster. Even if some players are impatient to start the game immediately, I hope you can refer to the tutorials in the game instruction specifically when encountering problems in the game to avoid unnecessary detours.

[h1][b]About the campaign mode[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902448/81ef431ab4a982d302da2906f5df8db74d9540da.png[/img]
There are a total of 32 single-player missions in the game, with 8 single-player missions each for the United States, China, Russia, and Europe. These missions have different levels of difficulty. I suggest that players start with the campaigns of the United States and China because they are slightly easier than the campaigns of Russia and Europe. Players should pay attention to the mission objectives before starting a single-player mission, which are not limited to aerial combat but also require the player to have the ability to control the aircraft to attack enemy ground targets. 

Some common mission objectives include destroying enemy aerial vehicles, destroying enemy ground vehicles, protecting our ground or air units (if they are destroyed, the mission is considered a failure), controlling a designated airport (only ground forces can control airports. Considering the slow marching speed of ground forces, players can also complete the mission by destroying all possible targets that may threaten our ground forces, without waiting for the ground forces to move slowly to the airport). There are many ways to pass the game, and I hope players can use their own thinking to pass the game.

[h1][b]About the future of the game[/b][/h1]

The game is almost complete, but there is still plenty of room for improvement. First of all, I will try my best to implement the save function, so that players can save a game at key points during single player missions. This way, if a mistake is made during gameplay, they do not have to start the game over from the beginning. I am also considering implementing a mission editor, so that players can create their own combat missions in the editor and share them with other players using the relevant features of the steam workshop. In addition, my future goals include adding more aircrafts and multiplayer mode to the game. And it is also possible to develop a 3D version of this game.

If any players encounter any bugs or other issues during the game, please feel free to give me feedbacks. I will do my best to fix and improve them. Thank you for your support, and I hope you enjoy my game!
